{"effort": "high", "extra": {}, "messages": [["user", "## Scenario

Protected species incident filings, investigation durations, and penalty assessments across regional enforcement registries, 2023–2024

The National Wildlife Law Enforcement Division maintains an incident and compliance registry logging protected species violations, strandings, and unauthorized habitat disturbances across regional field offices. Field agents and registry intake officers recorded case progression stages, field response times, staff investigation hours, and assessed civil penalties from January 2023 through December 2024 to evaluate enforcement pipeline efficiency and backlog resolution.

## Columns

| Column | Kind | Declared as |
|---|---|---|
| `case_stage` | category | Initial Intake, Field Assessment, Active Investigation, Formal Enforcement, Case Closed; ordered=stage; group workflow |
| `district` | category | Northwest Coastal, California Inland, Alaska Marine, Northeast Maritime, Mid-Atlantic Wetlands, Southeast Coastal, Gulf Coast Plains, Rio Grande Corridor, Great Lakes Basin; within region; group jurisdiction |
| `evidence_sufficiency_score` | measure | unit points; non-additive |
| `filing_month` | time | 2023-01-01 to 2024-12-31, monthly; group calendar |
| `incident_type` | category | Illegal Take, Stranding & Distress, Habitat Encroachment, Prohibited Commerce; group incident |
| `investigation_hours` | measure | unit hours; additive |
| `penalty_assessed_usd` | measure | unit USD; additive |
| `quarter` | category | 2023-Q1, 2023-Q2, 2023-Q3, 2023-Q4, 2024-Q1, 2024-Q2, 2024-Q3, 2024-Q4; ordered=ordinal; derived from filing_month; group calendar |
| `region` | category | Pacific West, Atlantic Coast, Gulf & Interior; group jurisdiction |
| `response_time_days` | measure | unit days; additive |

## Figures

- `f01`
    p0: waterfall, grouped by case_stage, COUNT(*)
    p0 reads case_stage off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: How case filings drop off through sequential stages from intake to closure
- `f02`
    p0: bar, grouped by incident_type, AVG(penalty_assessed_usd), unit USD
    p0 reads incident_type off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: Which incident types incur the highest average civil penalties
- `f03`
    p0: line, grouped by filing_month, SUM(investigation_hours), unit hours
    p0 reads filing_month off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: Monthly trend in total enforcement investigation hours logged
